description: The Acer Aspire One A114-45 is a lightweight and reliable laptop designed for everyday productivity. Powered by the Intel Celeron N4500 processor, it features 8GB LPDDR4 RAM and a 256GB SSD for smooth performance and fast storage access. The 14-inch WXGA display delivers clear visuals, while Intel UHD Graphics handles daily multimedia tasks with ease. Weighing just 1.3 kg, this sleek Pure Silver laptop is ideal for students, professionals, and users on the go.
